title: A promise with room for two
meaning: Your promises can stay warm when they express a living choice by both people and can hold difficult feelings.
text: Some important words sound familiar because they rest on a shared understanding of closeness. The Hierophant in the physical position of Vishuddha suggests expressing it through promises, recognised rules and phrases you both understand. The Lovers in energy support freely choosing each other, speaking for the sake of connection while considering both people's actual wishes. Strength in emotions brings gentle steadiness: you can hear something difficult and preserve respect. Participation gives a promise weight beyond the solemnity of its wording.

Suppose you agree to support each other at a large gathering if either feels uncomfortable. One person needs help joining a conversation; the other needs the possibility of leaving a little earlier. **A shared promise becomes personal when it holds different requests.** You can respond differently to the evening and remain on the same side. A brief word of support then confirms a real choice to stay connected, with room for each person's experience.

The vulnerable point is making a beautiful general promise without clarifying its meaning in this situation. Each person supplies a different interpretation, and support may go unrecognised when needed. The wish to preserve connection remains, but the familiar phrase has proved broader than the specific request. A little clarity in the details helps your word become something you can fulfil while keeping its warmth.
